death_sites.place: Nonoti River low-level bridge (MR01), near KwaDukuza town
death_sites.census_place_name: Nonoti (KwaDukuza LM, iLembe). KwaDukuza LM: isiZulu 66.08, English 20.80, isiXhosa 6.97. Note a different 'Nonoti' main place exists in eThekwini (isiZulu 94.18) - not used.
death_sites.count_note: FloodList: 'a vehicle was washed off a low-lying bridge on the MR01 ... a 28-year-old female ... was swept away'. Witness/LNN places it at 'a low-level bridge near KwaDukuza town' over the Nonoti River (https://witness.co.za/lnn/1167966/woman-and-vehicle-swept-away-by-floods-in-kwadukuza-kzn/). FloodList lists the Umgeni municipality among responding areas, which conflicts; KwaDukuza location used. Road-crossing death: victim may not have lived in the place.

notes: Single death. An IOL/Post item reports a separate Nonoti River flash-flood death at a family gathering (breadwinner, 36) - possibly a second death for this storm; not added because FloodList total is 1 and age differs (36 vs 28). Victim identity/language not inferred.

death_sites.census_place_name: Hammanskraal (City of Tshwane); adjacent Temba main place: Setswana 49.38, Sepedi 15.64, Xitsonga 11.54, English 2.32 - https://census2011.adrianfrith.com/place/799008
death_sites.count_note: 'Three young people died in a storm water trench in Hammanskraal on 21 November.' Exact section not stated.

notes: FloodList mentions no warnings. Pretoria/Centurion/Hennopspark affected without deaths.
